name: svg-french-press-pareto-v2-s2-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1450" width="1000" height="1450">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steelH" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#83898f"/>
      <stop offset="0.18" stop-color="#c9ced3"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#f4f6f7"/>
      <stop offset="0.72" stop-color="#c9ced3"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7f868c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="discGrad" cx="0.5" cy="0.42" r="0.65">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef0f2"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#ccd2d6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#aab1b6"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="lidTop" cx="0.5" cy="0.4" r="0.7">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2f4f5"/>
      <stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#cfd5d9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b2b9be"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="knobGrad" cx="0.35" cy="0.3" r="0.9">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7c8288"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#33373a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0f1112"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassH" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9fc4d2" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="0.18" stop-color="#eef9fc" stop-opacity="0.75"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#cfe9f1" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
      <stop offset="0.82" stop-color="#e8f6fa" stop-opacity="0.65"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8fb6c6" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0 0 L6 6 M6 0 L0 6 M0 3 H6 M3 0 V6" stroke="#949ca2" stroke-width="0.55" fill="none"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="1450" fill="#fbfbf9"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="500" y="42" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="6" fill="#2c3237">FRENCH PRESS</text>
  <text x="500" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" letter-spacing="1" fill="#6a7278">Exploded assembly view — three-piece plunger filter</text>

  <!-- centerline -->
  <line x1="500" y1="88" x2="500" y2="1400" stroke="#b3b7ba" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="12 9"/>

  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="1374" rx="175" ry="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>

  <!-- ===================== KNOB ===================== -->
  <circle cx="500" cy="110" r="32" fill="url(#knobGrad)" stroke="#0d0f10" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="489" cy="99" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#9aa1a7" opacity="0.55"/>
  <rect x="481" y="136" width="38" height="12" rx="5" fill="#2b2d2f"/>

  <!-- ===================== PLUNGER ROD ===================== -->
  <rect x="494" y="148" width="12" height="288" rx="3" fill="url(#steelH)" stroke="#7c8288" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <rect x="491" y="422" width="18" height="12" rx="2.5" fill="#9aa0a6" stroke="#7c8288" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- ===================== LID ===================== -->
  <path d="M 337 506 L 337 534 Q 500 558 663 534 L 663 506 Z" fill="url(#steelH)" stroke="#8a9096" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="506" rx="163" ry="26" fill="url(#lidTop)" stroke="#8a9096" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="506" rx="118" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#c2c8cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="506" rx="15" ry="6" fill="#4e5256" stroke="#3b3e41" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Upper filter part: perforated spring plate with peripheral coil -->
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="655" rx="126" ry="37" fill="url(#discGrad)" stroke="#84898e" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <g fill="#fbfbf9" stroke="#929aa0" stroke-width="1">
    <ellipse cx="424" cy="654" rx="18" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="456" cy="638" rx="18" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="634" rx="18" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="544" cy="638" rx="18" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="576" cy="654" rx="18" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="456" cy="672" rx="18" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="500" cy="676" rx="18" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="544" cy="672" rx="18" ry="5"/>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="655" rx="125" ry="37" fill="none" stroke="#777f86" stroke-width="9"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="655" rx="125" ry="37" fill="none" stroke="#e2e6e9" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="655" rx="11" ry="5.5" fill="#565b60" stroke="#3f4347"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="655" rx="5" ry="2.4" fill="#fbfbf9"/>

  <!-- ===================== MESH FILTER SCREEN ===================== -->
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="790" rx="127" ry="38" fill="#c7ccd0" stroke="#878d93" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="790" rx="118" ry="33.5" fill="#e4e7e9"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="790" rx="118" ry="33.5" fill="url(#mesh)"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="790" rx="118" ry="33.5" fill="none" stroke="#9aa1a7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="790" rx="10" ry="4.6" fill="#5c6165" stroke="#44484c" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Lower filter part: open cross plate, with integral threaded stud -->
  <path d="M374 914 a126 37 0 1 0 252 0 a126 37 0 1 0 -252 0
           M385 914 a115 30 0 1 0 230 0 a115 30 0 1 0 -230 0"
        fill="url(#steelH)" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="#84898e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <path d="M486 878 L514 878 L514 907 L625 907 L625 921 L514 921 L514 950 L486 950 L486 921 L375 921 L375 907 L486 907 Z"
        fill="url(#discGrad)" stroke="#84898e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="914" rx="17" ry="7" fill="#919ba3" stroke="#707980"/>
  <rect x="494" y="876" width="12" height="38" fill="url(#steelH)" stroke="#7c8288"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="876" rx="6" ry="2.5" fill="#dce0e3" stroke="#7c8288"/>
  <path d="M494 884 L506 880 M494 891 L506 887 M494 898 L506 894 M494 905 L506 901"
        stroke="#6c737a" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/>

  <!-- ===================== GLASS CARAFE ===================== -->
  <path d="M 344 1000 C 318 1002 296 1014 282 1032 C 276 1040 284 1048 293 1042 C 312 1029 332 1022 356 1019 Z"
        fill="#dceef4" opacity="0.95" stroke="#9fb9c4" stroke-width="0.9"/>
  <path d="M 350 1012 L 368 1350 Q 369 1367 386 1367 L 614 1367 Q 631 1367 632 1350 L 650 1012 Z"
        fill="url(#glassH)" stroke="#7fa3b0" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <path d="M 350 1012 L 344 1000 L 356 1019 Z" fill="#cfe6ee" stroke="#7fa3b0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="1012" rx="150" ry="26" fill="#d8ecf3" stroke="#8fb0bc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="1013" rx="139" ry="22.5" fill="#c2dbe4"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="1013" rx="131" ry="20.5" fill="#eef8fb"/>
  <rect x="376" y="1050" width="14" height="270" rx="7" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.55"/>
  <rect x="398" y="1050" width="6" height="270" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d="M 645 1035 C 715 1045 740 1120 726 1180 C 716 1222 688 1245 646 1238 L 646 1210 C 678 1214 696 1198 702 1170 C 712 1122 694 1074 645 1066 Z"
        fill="#1e2124" stroke="#0c0e0f" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M 655 1046 C 710 1058 726 1114 716 1166" fill="none" stroke="#4a5055" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- ===================== LEADER LINES + LABELS ===================== -->
  <g stroke="#9aa0a5" stroke-width="1.4">
    <line x1="254" y1="100" x2="462" y2="100"/>
    <line x1="254" y1="517" x2="333" y2="517"/>
    <line x1="254" y1="655" x2="376" y2="655"/>
    <line x1="254" y1="914" x2="371" y2="914"/>
    <line x1="748" y1="300" x2="514" y2="300"/>
    <line x1="748" y1="790" x2="631" y2="790"/>
    <line x1="748" y1="1140" x2="734" y2="1140"/>
    <line x1="748" y1="1300" x2="642" y2="1300"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#6b7278">
    <circle cx="466" cy="100" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="333" cy="517" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="380" cy="655" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="371" cy="914" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="511" cy="300" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="628" cy="790" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="731" cy="1140" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="639" cy="1300" r="3"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="600" fill="#3a3f44">
    <text x="246" y="106" text-anchor="end">Knob</text>
    <text x="246" y="523" text-anchor="end">Lid</text>
    <text x="246" y="661" text-anchor="end">Spring plate</text>
    <text x="246" y="920" text-anchor="end">Cross plate</text>
    <text x="756" y="306">Plunger rod</text>
    <text x="756" y="796">Mesh filter screen</text>
    <text x="756" y="1146">Handle</text>
    <text x="756" y="1306">Glass carafe</text>
  </g>

  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#777f86">
    <text x="246" y="683" text-anchor="end">Coiled spring seals the edge</text>
    <text x="756" y="818">Fine woven stainless steel</text>
    <text x="246" y="942" text-anchor="end">Threaded stud secures the stack</text>
  </g>
  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="500" y="1434" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="#8a9197">Filter stack, top to bottom: spring plate → mesh screen → cross plate. Stud threads into the plunger rod.</text>
</svg>
